Pandas.project: Clean and analyze a messy CSV dataset (missing values, duplicates, formatting issues)
Pandas.why_it_matters: Pandas is the standard tool for data manipulation in Python - nearly every data science workflow depends on it daily.

NumPy.why_it_matters: NumPy powers fast numerical computation under the hood of most ML libraries - understanding it helps you understand how models actually work.

Vector Databases.why_it_matters: Vector databases power modern AI search and RAG systems - increasingly a required skill for AI engineering roles.
